item.bmcrm.tuning_fork.unlinked: This crystal isn't linked to a resonator yet
bmcrm.ponder.resonator_base.text_1: The Resonator interacts with nearby crystals
bmcrm.ponder.resonator_base.text_2: A single crystal can only correctly resonate with one Resonator
bmcrm.ponder.resonator_base.text_3: Adding a second Resonator nearby creates dissonance
bmcrm.ponder.resonator_base.text_4: Multiple crystals can be used within the same Resonator
bmcrm.ponder.resonator_base.text_5: A Tuning Fork can be used to show the Resonator's range
bmcrm.ponder.resonator_interference.head: Interference
bmcrm.ponder.resonator_interference.text: A Resonator is vulnerable to interference
For example, rain near its operating area will reduce the chance of success
It's best to keep your Resonator free from distractions
bmcrm.ponder.resonator_modulators.text_1: Modulators are special blocks that modify how the Resonator interacts with nearby crystals
bmcrm.ponder.resonator_modulators.text_2: They can be placed as part of your crystal arrangement
bmcrm.ponder.resonator_modulators.text_3: Some Modulators have an area of effect, and others affect the entire system
bmcrm.ponder.modulator_silk_touch.text_1: The Silk Touch Modulator allows you to obtain ore blocks instead of raw ore
bmcrm.ponder.modulator_silk_touch.text_2: The Silk Touch Modulator affects all crystals directly surrounding it
bmcrm.ponder.modulator_fortune.text_1: Fortune Modulators apply the Fortune enchantment on the crystal whenever it generates resources
bmcrm.ponder.modulator_fortune.text_2: The Fortune Modulator operates on a 5x5 plus
bmcrm.ponder.modulator_fortune.text_3: Multiple Fortune Modulators can affect one crystal
bmcrm.ponder.modulator_fortune.text_4: A Silk Touch Modulator disables the effects of any Fortune Modulators
bmcrm.ponder.modulator_auto_smelt.text_1: The Auto-Smelt Modulator affects any crystals that sit between it and the Resonator
bmcrm.ponder.modulator_auto_smelt.text_2: Any crystal that does not intersect an Auto-Smelt Modulator does not get affected
bmcrm.ponder.tag.creating_crystals.descr: Forming blank crystals, infusing them with a resource, and melting them down
bmcrm.ponder.tag.using_crystals.descript: Resonators, and the Modulators that shape what they produce
bmcrm.ponder.shared.machine_power: The %s requires energy to operate. It can be provided with fuel, or supplied via RF
bmcrm.ponder.machine_former.text_1: The Crystal Former is used to create blank crystals
bmcrm.ponder.machine_former.text_2: It takes a while to form a crystal...
bmcrm.ponder.machine_former.text_3: When it's done, you can take the crystal and start Infusing it at the Crystal Infuser
bmcrm.ponder.machine_infuser.text_1: The crystal infuser turns your blank crystals into usable crystals
bmcrm.ponder.machine_infuser.text_2: You'll need to infuse 32 of any resource into the crystal to attune it to that resource
bmcrm.ponder.machine_infuser.text_3: It is not possible to change the resource afterwards, or to mix different resources
bmcrm.ponder.machine_crucible.text_1: Whenever a Resonator interacts with a crystal, the crystal gains Liquid Resonance
bmcrm.ponder.machine_crucible.text_2: The Crystal Crucible can be used to melt down crystals, harvesting the Liquid Resonance stored inside
bmcrm.ponder.machine_crucible.text_3: Melting a crystal destroys it, so only melt one once it has soaked up all it can hold
bmcrm.ponder.machine_crucible.text_4: Liquid resonance can be used to create new materials and better crystals
bmcrm.ponder.crystal_blank.text_1: Blank Crystals can be created using the Crystal Former
bmcrm.ponder.crystal_blank.text_2: There are %s different types of Blank Crystal you can form
bmcrm.ponder.crystal_blank.text_3: The blank crystal sets how often it resonates, and how much resonance it can hold
bmcrm.ponder.crystal_infusing.text_1: A Blank crystal doesn't do anything on its own, it needs to be infused
bmcrm.ponder.crystal_infusing.text_2: Many materials can be infused into crystals
bmcrm.ponder.crystal_infusing.text_3: You cannot infuse a crystal with multiple materials
